prScope: PRs updated in the selected local dates across this GitHub repository, including open and closed PRs. This is not a list of PRs merged during those dates.
commitScope: Commits on the current branch's first-parent history, using the selected local dates.
prTransfer: GitHub receives {repository}; Atlas requests its public PR list. This read sends no Git credentials, commit messages or code.
prEmpty: No PRs updated in these dates were returned. GitHub's changing list may have omissions.
prPartial: PR list reading stopped before finishing these dates or reaching the end of the list. More PRs may be missing.
prFailed: Could not read the PR list. Earlier results stay available; check the connection and retry.
prCoverage: Examined {scanned} PR entries on GitHub; {shown} distinct PRs have update dates in this period. The list can change while it is read.
prSaved: Saved copy linked to a commit in these dates. Atlas has not checked this copy against GitHub.
linkedUnchecked: {count} commits have not been checked for matching PRs.
linkedUnlinked: {count} PR candidates could not be tied to these commits and were excluded from the linked-history list.
preview: ACP part turns Atlas will send: {parts}. Review the originals, your request and omissions. Runtime setup and provider-internal network request counts are unknown.
destination: {agent} may send these records and anything its tools read to its provider. Review tool permission requests as they appear.
folder: Agent working folder: {folder}. The selected repository is not the agent's working folder.
working: The agent is explaining part {current} of {total}.
stopped: Stopped. Completed parts and the original PRs are kept. Check each part’s delivery status before continuing.
failed: The agent could not finish this part. The PRs and completed parts are kept; check whether it was sent before retrying.
invalid: The agent's answer cites missing or unavailable PR passages. It was not added to the explanation; inspect the answer or retry.
stale: The repository, dates, agent or PR records changed. The previous explanation keeps its original scope; prepare again to continue.
unverified: The explanation interprets PR author records. It does not verify code behavior or test results.
partialResult: This explanation is partial. Open coverage for records that were not read, sent, cited or explained.
noAgent: No supported coding agent is ready. Set up an agent, then return to this request; the PRs stay available.
noRecords: Choose at least one complete PR record to prepare an explanation.
web: Reading local Git history and running a coding agent need the installed app.
privateTransfer: GitHub CLI will use {account} on github.com to request PRs from {repository}. The account's existing permissions apply. Atlas keeps private originals only in this app session; sending them to an agent may create copies elsewhere.
privateUnavailable: Could not read this repository with the selected GitHub CLI account. Check its repository access and pull request read permission, then retry.
githubNotReady: GitHub CLI is unavailable or not signed in on this Mac. Read public PRs or set up GitHub CLI and retry.
commitNone: Choose at least one complete commit record to prepare an explanation.
filesScope: Files touched by first-parent commits in the selected period. Opening a file compares the selected period's endpoints.
filesFromCommit: View files touched by this commit
filesFromPr: View files touched in this period
filesFromPrNote: These are files touched in the selected period, not a verified list of files changed by this PR.
filesEmpty: No files were recorded for this scope. Choose another period or return.
filePartial: Some file changes could not be read. Refresh or return to the file list.
chooseFile: Select a file to compare for this period.
selectionFiltered: The open file does not match your search. Select a match or clear the search to navigate.
noFileMatch: No files match this search. Clear the search to see all files.
periodBasis: Compares {before} to {after}, not a single PR or commit. Intervening changes may fall outside the selected dates.
accountPinUnsupported: Atlas cannot safely keep this GitHub account fixed during reading. Public PR reading is still available.
scanCannotContinue: This page is still too large to read. Earlier PRs remain available; stop or open the repository on GitHub.
unverifiedRuntime: Atlas cannot verify this agent’s permissions. Choose another agent or review its setup.
agentPermissions: Review what this agent can read, write, run and send. Unverified access is marked unknown.
notSent: Part {part} was not sent. Retry when ready.
deliveryUnknown: Delivery of part {part} is unconfirmed. The agent may have received it.
retryWarning: The agent may have received this part. Sending it again may duplicate the request.
citationLimit: Citations locate passages; they do not prove the explanation is supported.
versionConflict: PR #{number} was seen in multiple versions. Review the available versions before sending.
prCoverageAtLeast: Reviewed {scanned} entries; at least {shown} distinct PRs were updated in this period. The list may change while reading.
originalsOmitted: Some originals could not be read or were too large.
conflictsUnknown: Some PR version changes could not be checked.
sessionLimit: The limit for PR copies in this app session was reached. Clear the saved session copies to continue.
retainedVersions: Earlier observed versions are also kept. Open an original to see when it was read.
restartRead: The previous read was interrupted and its continuation is uncertain. Read again.
noRemote: Could not identify a public GitHub repository for this source.
shortScope: Updated in this period · open and closed PRs
prUnavailablePublic: Could not read public PRs. Check the connection and whether the repository is accessible.
remoteReadFailed: Could not read the repository’s GitHub address.
findPr: Find loaded PRs by title or number
noPrMatch: No loaded PRs match. Clear the search to see all loaded PRs.
previousCombinedScope: Commit messages and PR descriptions matched to them. This is not the full PR list.
combinedRunning: The combined briefing is still running.
questionDefault: Explain the changes, why they were made, reported checks, and known limitations.
manualNotice: Atlas does not send this request. Your agent may read other files or send data according to its settings.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the packet text and copy it manually.
omittedOverlarge: PR #{number}: original exceeds the part limit
previewEmpty: Enter a question and select at least one PR.
previewStale: The repository or PRs changed or cannot be checked. Check the repository or refresh, then prepare again.
appAgentUnavailable: In-app agent analysis is not available yet.
questionTooLong: The question is too long. Shorten it and try again.
copiedRequest: Copied. Paste it into your coding agent.
nativeOmittedUnlisted: Additional omitted PRs could not be identified.
